messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: High error rate (5xx) detected for customer 'Sentinel' in dedicated VPC pool 'sentinel-prod-1'. Severity: P1. Paging oncall.
raj: I'm on it, joining bridge. Seeing spikes from tenant ID t-sentinel-42, 90% of errors are OOM or CUDA driver resets.
emma: oncall handoff — taking lead for mitigation. raj handing off live.
raj: passing to emma. CPU/GPU metrics and pod restarts in the bridge. logs: ```2026-03-17T10:12:23Z ERROR inference: kvcache::alloc failed: OOM```
emma: Thanks. julian_ops can you confirm whether this tenant is pinned to the pool or bursting?
julian_ops: Sentinel is in a dedicated pool (reserved GPUs), but we see a noisy tenant pattern — their batch sizes spiked and used >75% of GPU memory across nodes. They are pinned, not bursting.
sre-lead: moving to isolation plan. Proposed steps: 1) scale out pool by +2 GPUs (if capacity). 2) apply transient tenant-level throttling for t-sentinel-42. 3) failover most traffic to read-only fallback model (cpu-backed) for non-critical requests.
emma: Can we isolate tenant to its own node? That will require migration; risk of evicting other tenants. julian_ops: We can cordon one node and drain other tenants off it, then bind t-sentinel-42 to that node. Time estimate ~8-12m.
eng-runtime: We have a hotfix to reduce KV cache prefetching per-request. Patch ready for hot-restart; should reduce memory delta by ~20%. Rollout in 2m.
raj: I'll start the patch rollout to one replica as a canary.
emma: paging execs and CS. @maria-cs can you prepare an initial customer note? We need ETA and mitigation summary.
maria-cs: On it. Initial message: "We're investigating elevated errors affecting your inference calls; we've isolated the issue to memory pressure from large batch sizes and have applied a mitigation. We'll update in 30 minutes."
incident-bot: BRIDGE created: https://redwood/bridges/1768804321 - bridge owner emma.
eng-runtime: Canary patch applied to replica r12. Monitoring memory and error rate.
eng-runtime: Canary shows errors down ~60%, latency stable. Proceeding with pool-wide restart of service processes (graceful).
emma: Proceed with pool-wide roll, do rolling restart with 30s stagger. julian_ops to coordinate node cordon for tenant isolation after restarts.
julian_ops: Rolling restart started. Also creating a temporary rate-limit policy: requests/sec cap = 5k for t-sentinel-42.
sre-lead: Add fallback route rule: if errors > 5% for 60s, route new sessions to encrypted fallback in region-us-east-1-fallback.
eng-runtime: Roll complete. Error rate reduced to baseline ~0.5%. Memory pressure dropped.
emma: Good. Confirming isolation: t-sentinel-42 bound to node n-12. No other tenants on that node.
maria-cs: Customer update sent: "We applied a mitigation and isolated your workload to a dedicated node. We're continuing to monitor and will follow up with a full RCA and any credit/SLAs if needed."
raj: Quick impact summary to record: duration ~39 min, total requests affected ~12k, error rate peak 28%, estimated 0.8% of customer's calls failed to return valid completions.
sre-lead: Post-incident actions: - Run RCA. - Evaluate whether pinning policy prevented preemption from harmless tenants. - Enhance autoscale thresholds for memory signals. - Add per-tenant soft limits on batch size.
emma: Working on RCA draft. I'll capture timeline and mitigation steps, root cause hypothesis: unbounded client-side batching combined with a model update that increased KV cache size by ~18%.
maria-cs: Preparing customer-facing RCA outline + exec summary for Monday. Need approval on credits: recommend 10% pro-rated credit for affected timeslot.
sre-lead: Approve provisional 10% credit. Finance OKs to propose initially; escalate if customer pushes back.
eng-runtime: Action item: deploy KV cache cap (#1237) to production next week and add telemetry to detect sudden per-tenant cache growth.
emma: Assignments: emma -> RCA draft + timeline; eng-runtime -> KV cap PR and telemetry; julian_ops -> run isolation playbook and update runbook docs; maria-cs -> customer comm + exec summary; raj -> postmortem verification and metrics graphs.
maria-cs: Draft to customer will include: timeline, what we did, root cause (investigation in progress), mitigations underway, proposed credit, next steps.
emma: ETA for RCA draft? EOD today for initial draft, final RCA by Wednesday.
sre-lead: Add notes for SLA review — sentinel is on enterprise plan, credit might trigger SLA review with legal.
maria-cs: Noted. I'll flag legal and AM.
raj: Closing bridge in 10. Will keep monitoring for 2 hours.
emma: Thanks everyone. Thread will be used for post-incident comms and to assemble final RCA. :thumbsup:
